description: Owner-private reversible archive and pin lifecycle structural boundary. Shared catalog assets are read-only and cannot be private lifecycle targets. Authoritative server checks enforce ownership, session binding, revision and pin compare-and-swap, immutable idempotent receipts, archive dependencies, reference completeness and retention eligibility. Archive never erases original bytes, provenance, reviews or existing pins. Eligibility is diagnostic; purge remains disabled. A schema does not authorize deletion, public release or a shared catalog change.
